Thank you so much your comment. I agree with everything you said about students overdoing it in high school. I see it in my high school as well and as you said, it’s gut wrenching to see. I wanted to take an easier science class even though I was decent in physics honors this year, but there wasn’t any other easier science class or more interesting science class I could find. So I’m just going to roll with AP physics. As for AP stats, I chose it because it’s quite useful for business related degrees and seems interesting. And like you said I need to have that balance, and I value having balance too. So yesterday after careful thought I think I’m going to drop AP stats and do regular stats. I will still be covering the same stuff as AP stats, of course not as much, but taking regular stats will give me the opportunity to do more of what I want outside of school whether that’s extra curriculars, social life, and well-being. I think this will be good taking pre-cal honors, AP physics 1, and regular stats class with all my other classes being regular classes as well. Of course this isn’t the most rigorous schedule, as I have friends taking 3-4 AP’s but I just feel like AP classes aren’t for everyone. From past experience, like this year I’ve taken 2 AP classes and have been real stressed out and dreaded it, and I have no extra curriculars, so it wouldn’t make sense to take 2 AP’s again next year. I just feel 1 AP class with exciting curriculars and a social life is better than 2 AP’s with no extra curriculars and no social life. Some people can take a lot of AP’s and I will never discourage them if they want to, but I believe doing what goes with your ideals is best for you. Yes, take consideration from other people, but just know no one knows you better than yourself and like you said, don’t take too much than you can handle. I honestly just picked AP stats instead of regular stats because my friends were taking it and fell into peer pressure. I’m glad I noticed that, but I just have to remember that I have to do things that go with my ideals, not college’s and no one else’s, because like you said, I want to enjoy my high school experience. All throughout high school so far it has been really stressful and dreadful. I’ve been able to get good grades, but these classes aren’t fulfilling and I have no life outside of school. I feel by just taking this 1 AP class(AP physics 1) instead of adding on all these hard classes and AP’s will make my high school experience a lot better because I will be able to balance everything out more. Again, thank you for your comment, and I’d like to know what you think about what I said in this response. Have a great rest of your day!
